title: Shared taxonomy
description: The vocabulary of anchor skills: the skills that belong to no module and that modules name to build on one another. Its instance is the ID of an anchor skill, core.<name>: a skill of a module names one among its prerequisites or in teaches, and a manifest in its dependencies. It describes no part of a module, and it refuses an ID that names no anchor skill. Each anchor skill is a branch of oneOf, with its ID, its title and its description, all in English; the description is normative, since it is what the skill means.

oneOf.title: Multiplication table
oneOf.description: Knows the product of any two whole numbers from 1 to 10, and divides such a product by either of them: 7 × 8 = 56 and 56 ÷ 8 = 7.

oneOf.title: Division with a remainder
oneOf.description: Divides a whole number by a whole number from 1 to 10 and gives the whole quotient and the remainder, which is less than the divisor: 47 ÷ 6 = 7, remainder 5.

oneOf.title: Fractions of a whole
oneOf.description: Names a part of a whole split into equal parts as a fraction, such as 3/4 of a shape, and finds a fraction of a whole number, such as 2/3 of 12.

oneOf.title: Linear equations
oneOf.description: Solves an equation of the first degree in one unknown, such as 3x + 5 = 20, and checks the solution by putting it back into the equation.
